svg.title: Software Architecture
svg.desc: Software Architecture. I enjoy designing systems that are clean, scalable, and understandable. Good architecture feels almost invisible. I care about: Clear abstractions, Scalable backends, Reliable APIs, Developer experience, System design, Performance, Maintainability, Elegant technical decisions. I like software that is not only functional, but well thought out.
